NewsArticle.Title: Nightmare of the Marauder
NewsArticle.Content:
Varuna, the Mukul Historian, tells a legend of a marauder that pillaged the Mukul in the ancient wastelands.
Rogues with eighty insights: Discover Varuna and the nightmare that plagued the Mukul.
Dream of the Marauder of the ancient wastelands and become the Marauder.
